why:
Must_not item 1 is avoided. The verifier's Check 3 script goes through every exported function, so a README with a padLeft section but no slugify section prints FAIL.

Must_not item 2 is broken. Check 1 adds a signature requirement: "confirm that padLeft is an exported function whose parameters are (s, width, fill), in that order", and it fails if "the exported signature is not padLeft(s, width, fill)". Line 1 is about behaviour: padding on the left, with a space as the default fill. A correct padLeft(str, len, ch) would fail this check, and must_not names parameter checks as stricter than the line.

Check 3 also requires a README layout. Its regex only accepts a heading at level ## or deeper that starts with the function name, so a real section such as "### The slugify function" would be listed as missing.

Checks 2 and 4 match their lines. The multi-character fill note is advisory only.
